Plan approval moves out of the engine's full-screen dialog into a card above the prompt, with the plan itself in the preview pane.

- When Claude finishes a plan (`ExitPlanMode`), a plan card opens above the prompt and the plan file opens in the preview pane beside the chat, so the transcript and panes stay visible
- With an empty prompt, `1` approves: Claude Code leaves plan mode for the mode you were in before, as the dialog's first choice does. `2` brings the plan pane to the front
- Write what to change in the card and press Enter to send the plan back; Claude stays in plan mode and asks again with a revised plan
- `9` hands the plan to the engine dialog, for its other choices such as approving with manual edit approval
- As with the question card: one terminal only, a notification when it opens (`askNotify`), and with Remote Control it hands over to the engine dialog after a minute untouched. Sessions without a plan file keep the engine dialog
- A rejected plan in the transcript now shows the plan it rejected instead of "no plan text"

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
